features.what: Shows how many sessions are published and which ones would look unfinished on the public agenda.
steps: Open Marketing > Event Webpages > Agenda Webpage > General-Purpose.
Read the problem list.
Click Fix in Session Manager next to a problem, or Session Manager under the title.
Click View the live page to check the result.
features.statusNote: Report only. Sessions are edited in Session Manager and show on /agenda on the next load.

features.what: Lists a ready link to the public agenda for each day and each track.
steps: Open Marketing > Event Webpages > Agenda Webpage > Special-Purpose.
Find the day or track in the table.
Click its link in the URL column. The filtered agenda opens in a new tab.
Copy the address from the browser.
features.statusNote: Checked live: /agenda?day= and /agenda?track= filter the public page. The screen has no copy button and nothing to save.

features.what: Shows clicks, orders and revenue for tracked links that point at the agenda.
steps: Open Marketing > Event Webpages > Agenda Webpage > Analytics.
Read the link table.
Click Campaign links to add a tracked link in Tickets > Ticket Marketing > Campaign Link Tracking.
features.statusNote: Counts tracked links only. No page views. No agenda link exists yet, so the table is empty.

features.what: Shows how many speakers are published and how many lack a photo, company or job title.
steps: Open Marketing > Event Webpages > Speaker Webpage.
Read the problem list.
Click Fix in Speaker Manager next to a problem, or Speaker Manager under the title.
features.statusNote: Report only. Speakers cannot be reordered or edited here.

features.what: Shows whether every sponsor has what the public sponsor page needs.
steps: Open Marketing > Event Webpages > Sponsor Webpage > Sponsor List.
Read the problem list.
Click Fix in Sponsor Manager next to a problem, or Sponsor Manager under the title.
features.statusNote: Report only. Sponsors are edited in Sponsor Manager.

features.what: Shows which sponsors have a logo on file, by tier.
steps: Open Marketing > Event Webpages > Sponsor Webpage > Sponsor Banner.
Scan the artwork table for missing logos.
Click Sponsor Manager to add a logo.
features.statusNote: No banner placement, rotation or impression counts exist. The app has no banner slot.

features.what: Shows which exhibitors are live on /exhibitors and which lack a logo or website.
steps: Open Marketing > Event Webpages > Exhibitor Webpage.
Read the problem list and the booth table.
Click Exhibitor Manager to confirm an exhibitor or add a logo.
features.statusNote: Report only. Confirming an exhibitor in Exhibitor Manager publishes them.

features.what: Shows which documents anyone can download at /documents and which are held back by ticket type.
steps: Open Marketing > Event Webpages > Artifact Webpage.
Read the table.
Click Documents to publish, restrict or add one.
features.statusNote: Report only. No download counts. Documents are links to files hosted elsewhere.

features.what: Shows where a visitor finds venue, dates, registration, travel and conduct answers on the public site.
steps: Open Marketing > Event Webpages > Logistics Webpage.
Read the table.
For day-of changes, click Announcements and post one.
features.statusNote: No logistics editor. Venue and travel text lives in site code and needs a deploy to change.

features.what: Lists the rooms a venue map would show and how many sessions use each.
steps: Open Marketing > Event Webpages > Venue Map Webpage.
Read the room table.
Click Floormap (in-app) for the map attendees see in the app.
features.statusNote: No floorplan upload and no pin placement. The public site has no map page.

features.what: Lists all 22 public pages, opens each one, and links to the screen where each is edited.
steps: Open Marketing > Event Website.
Click a page name to open it.
Click the link in the Edited from column to change that page's data.
Click Website Copy to edit Code of conduct, Call for posters or Startup pitch text.
features.statusNote: This screen edits nothing. It links to the editors. 13 pages change from the dashboard and 9 still need a developer. Custom pages are written on Content > Branding Center > Customize Resources. No branding or domain controls.

features.what: Shows clicks, orders and revenue for links that speakers and partners post.
steps: Open Marketing > Organizer Co-Promo.
Read the link table.
Click Create a tracked link. It opens Tickets > Ticket Marketing > Campaign Link Tracking.
features.statusNote: Report only. Links are made in Tickets > Ticket Marketing. There is no cross-event promotion.

features.what: Shows what a search result or shared link displays for the conference.
steps: Open Marketing, then My Event Listing.
Read the table.
features.statusNote: No directory listing exists. Site title, description and share image are code and need a deploy.

features.what: Shows clicks, orders and revenue for every tracked link.
steps: Open Marketing, then Traffic Analytics.
Read the table.
Click Create a tracked link. It opens Tickets > Ticket Marketing > Campaign Link Tracking.
features.statusNote: Counts tracked links only. No page views, referrers or chart.

features.what: Shows community board posts by category and which categories are safe to put on a screen.
steps: Open Marketing > Social Wall > Social Wall Customization.
Read the category table.
Click Moderate the board to hide a post.
features.statusNote: No public wall page exists. Nothing to customize or project.

features.what: Shows counts for attendee posts and announcements, and which of the two is public.
steps: Open Marketing > Social Wall > Activity Stream Webpage.
Click /announcements to see the public stream.
Click Announcements to post one.
features.statusNote: Only announcements are public. The attendee board is not published anywhere.

features.what: Shows clicks, orders and revenue for social links, by channel.
steps: Open Marketing > Social Media Center > Social Media Manager.
Read the channel and link tables.
Click Go to the post copy. It opens Tools > App Adoption > Social Media.
features.statusNote: Does not post or schedule. No connected accounts. You post by hand.

features.what: Lists where post copy, the adoption email, the download button, sponsor logos and speaker headshots live.
steps: Open Marketing > Social Media Center > Content Library.
Click the link in the Screen column to open an asset.
features.statusNote: An index of links. Stores nothing. No shareable graphics exist.

uiIssues.issue: Each screen puts its limits behind a small "i" next to the title. On a phone it is a tiny tap target.
uiIssues.fix: Open the tip on tap and keep it inside the viewport, or show one line under the title.

uiIssues.issue: The Venue tile prints the full address at stat-number size and wraps to four lines, making the tile row twice as tall. Also on /marketing/event-webpages/venue-map-webpage.
uiIssues.fix: Show the address at body size or move it out of the stat tiles.

uiIssues.issue: Tables name code paths to the organizer: "apps/web layout. Needs a deploy", "Rendered from ticketTypes on every request". /marketing/event-website says "code. Needs a deploy" on nine rows and adds a footnote about Firestore and React files.
uiIssues.fix: Say "Ask the developer" or "Edited in Create Tickets" and drop the footnotes.

uiIssues.issue: Whova Listing, Social Wall Customization and Venue Map Webpage are menu items for things that do not exist (tags read "not applicable", "no public wall", "0 of 8 pinned").
uiIssues.fix: Hide these three from the nav until they do something, or merge them into Event Website.

uiIssues.issue: Link labels in live data carry em dashes ("Speaker referral — Ada Lovelace"). Also shown on /marketing/whova-listing/traffic-analytics.
uiIssues.fix: Rename the links with a colon or comma in Campaign Link Tracking.

uiIssues.issue: The "Powered by Netlify" badge sits on top of the last table column and hides text ("static page. Needs a d..."). Seen on Logistics Webpage, Content Library and Special-Purpose.
uiIssues.fix: Turn off the Netlify badge in site settings.

uiIssues.issue: The empty-state box sits on top of the Orders and Net column headers, leaving stray vertical strips on both sides.
uiIssues.fix: Let the empty state fill the table width.
